title: The exact Spearman rho–footrule region via optimal transport with applications to finite rankings, mixability, and Chatterjee’s rank correlation

bindings.label: defmaxprob
bindings.note: The scalar native boundary is proved to be the uniquely attained maximum at every footrule in the stated interval.

verificationScope: The complete arXiv v1 manuscript is retained, with original result numbers, proofs, figures, author affiliations and bibliography. The source repeats one equation label: both equations remain distinct, and cross-references explicitly select the second occurrence, matching the last source definition. Rho and footrule definitions and Corollary 1.2 have independent typed encodings; the printed lower-bound power 3/2 is proved equal to the native formula on its stated interval. The final mixture paragraph of Corollary 1.2 is a checked proof document with the endpoint copulas supplied. Other links expose actual compiled native theorem types and their scope; they do not certify every word or every printed proof step. The abstract pair-measure representation, general constrained Kantorovich duality, the full source-to-native identification of the boundary construction, arbitrary continuously distributed random-variable translations, external literature claims, and numerical plots remain outside the checked document coverage.
